integrity: Reproducible C++17 census and independently checked SymPy affine-chart geometric smoothness and rational contact classifications. No independent external audit or validation has taken place.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite-field classification over F3 only; verified exhaustive coefficient-space and orbit computation; an earlier unpublished hyperflex-refined table remains possible. Frobenius-class results of Bergvall already provide related unrefined rational-bitangent counts and those unrefined frequencies are not claimed as new.
title: Hyperflex-refined rational bitangents of smooth plane quartics over \(\mathbf F_3\)
